description: Recommend a coherent icon set for up to 20 named UI slots in one call. Uses task context to narrow ambiguous meanings. When context is insufficient, returns needs_clarification with labeled interpretation options instead of guessing. Invalid inputs and service failures return a plain-language reason and a next step instead of a bare protocol error. Returns one recommendation and optional alternatives for each resolved slot, with explicit public library labels and visual preview URLs where available. Library key si means Supericons, not Simple Icons.

include_query_frame.description: Optional public-safe diagnostics for query understanding. Boolean strings are accepted. Leave false for normal compact responses.

library.description: Optional library key when the user wants a consistent icon family. Supported values include si (Supericons AI and developer tool logos), lucide, tabler, phosphor, heroicons, bootstrap, iconoir, ionicons, material, simpleicons (Simple Icons brand logos), and mingcute.

limit_per_slot.description: Number of choices per slot. Values outside 1 to 5 are clamped with a warning. Numeric strings are accepted.

locale.description: Optional locale for multilingual slot labels. Unsupported values are ignored with a warning.

response_mode.description: Response size mode: plan, assets, or full. Unsupported values use plan with a warning.

slots.description: List of 1 to 20 UI slots to fill, for example ["model", "prompt", "dataset", "evaluation"]. A single string is accepted as one slot. Lists of up to a few hundred slots return a structured split instruction; send at most 20 per call.

style.description: Optional style preference. Unsupported values are ignored with a warning.

task.description: Overall UI task, for example "choose icons for an AI dashboard sidebar" or "select bottom navigation icons for a finance app". Missing task text returns a structured recovery message.

name: recommend_icons

all_slots_resolved.description: Whether every requested slot received a recommendation without clarification.

clarification_slots.description: Slots that need the caller to choose an interpretation.

code.description: Stable error code for programmatic recovery.

error.description: Plain-language reason the recommendation did not complete.

fallback_recommended.description: Whether the caller should consider direct search or clarification.

library.description: Library filter used for recommendations, if provided.

low_confidence_slots.description: Slots whose result is missing or has low confidence.

needs_clarification.description: Whether one or more ambiguous slots require more context.

next_step.description: Useful next action for the caller.

preview_url.description: Browser URL for visual inspection of the recommended icon set.

query_frame.description: Optional public-safe query understanding diagnostics for the task.

response_mode.description: Response size mode used for this recommendation.

results.description: Recommended icon choices grouped by requested UI slot.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited recommendation.

retryable.description: Whether a corrected or later request may succeed.

search_runtime.description: Search execution path used for this recommendation.

status.description: HTTP status from a hosted dependency failure.

suggested_response_markdown.description: Plain-language explanation suitable for the agent response.

warnings.description: Unsupported optional inputs that were safely ignored or clamped.
